inspection: Official public JavaScript was inspected as source text and AST only. It was not executed. Chunk URLs came from the native entry runtime filename and public-path maps.

list.nativeEvidence: Bootstrap app/src/service/position/index.ts c6 -> B -> L calls getJobList. FilterPositionList constructs page.pageNo/pageSize, jobShareType, keywords and empty filter arrays. The native request wrapper calls client.post(url, payload, options).
list.publicPayload: page={pageNo:1,pageSize:10}; jobShareType=1; keywords=消防 or 机场; cityList, department, jfJgList, jobType, typeCode and specialCode are empty arrays; u_query_id and r_query_id are empty strings. No login material or local resume is included.
list.observedResponse: Both anonymous public reads returned HTTP200, status:1 and data:{list,page,traceId}. Each first page contained ten rows. The native totals were 58 and 11, but additional pages were not collected and totals do not establish relevant or applicable jobs.
list.rowSchema: jobUnionId/name/jobType/jobStatus/cityList/jobDuty/jobRequirement; all twenty observed rows had separate nonempty duties and requirements. firstPostTime and expiredTime were null; refreshTime is not a publication date or application deadline.
list.identity: Only native jobUnionId is authoritative. The public view uses /web/position/detail?jobUnionId=<id>&jobShareType=1. A role's duties and requirements belong only to its own row; desc or department prose cannot fill missing sections.
list.pagination: Native page 1 is internal page 1. A continuation is bound to site, origin, query hash, page and prior-page signatures. Internal page 20 explicitly marks limited coverage when more native pages exist. Actual coverage here is first-page-only.

detail.nativeEvidence: Bootstrap service xH -> O -> S calls getJobDetail; the detail model supplies {jobUnionId,jobShareType:1}. Returned ID and title must match the native list binding.
detail.applicationBoundary: The public detail view is a candidate only. No application form, login session, submission API or successful application is inferred or exercised. Missing application verification remains unknown.

recruitmentStatus: Native enum IN_RECRUITMENT=000; native UI treats 001 as offline. Status 000 is retained as source status and does not fabricate a dated recruitment window. A 001 row is closed. Refresh time is never a deadline.
tests: All role IDs, names, locations and prose in official-meituan-template.test.mjs are synthetic boundary controls. Tests use injected transports and no external requests.
privacy: No local resume, contacts, user workspace, credentials, trace ID, private filesystem path or private collection identifier is included.
